title: Headless TTW The Velvet Curtain (DLC04FF05): from the spy's safehouse terminal through the bank's box 1207, Yang's self-destruct codes, the sunken submarine and the Aviary's bunker to the escape from the double cross (stage 100, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), across to Point Lookout with The Local Flavor done (DLC04MQ01 200: its chain), standing on Point Lookout's landing (where the voyage puts the player [observed]). The Velvet Curtain (DLC04FF05) runs from the start [observed].

Path: the spy's safehouse terminal (Welcome to USA: stage 10, the contact tape), the locker key from the spy's luggage and the password tape from the contact locker, stepped away from (DLC04FF05PasswordHolotapeSCRIPT: 30), the password tape played at the bank's teller (DLC04FF05bankAudioCaptureSCRIPT: 40, box 1207 open), the debriefing tape from the box played (50), Yang's self-destruct codes from his morgue drawer (DLC04FF05dentalCapsuleSCRIPT's OnAdd: 60), the sunken submarine's terminal (65) and self-destruct switch, the sub blown once the player is out (70), the safehouse terminal's Extraction Details (80), the Cryptochromatic Spectacles and the Aviary's pedestal sequence (A C B C D D B: DLC04Puzzle03ControlBoxSCRIPT opens the spy bunker), the protectron's passphrase and walk (85), the extraction terminal (90) and the way out (DLC04FF05escapeTrigSCRIPT: 100).
Travel stand-in: to the Chinese spy's safehouse; its terminal's welcome entry gives the contact tape (stage 10) [observed: DLC04FF05safehouseTerminal].

Travel stand-in: to the Point Lookout motel; the spy's luggage case (DLC04FF05Luggage) holds the locker key, the contact locker (DLC04FF05ContactLocker) the password tape [observed: their CNTO]; everything in each is taken.
Stepping away from the locker leaves its trigger (DLC04FF05PasswordHolotapeSCRIPT's OnTriggerLeave): with the tape, 30 [observed].

Travel stand-in: to the Point Lookout bank's vault. In front of the teller the player plays the password tape (its line's end: HoloPlaying 1); the audio trigger (DLC04FF05bankAudioCaptureSCRIPT, OnTrigger while the player stands in it) hears it, and 10 s later the intercom accepts it and opens box 1207 (40) [observed].
Box 1207 open, the espionage debriefing tape inside is picked up and played (its line's end: 50; Wan Yang's locker drawer in the camp's morgue enabled) [observed].

Travel stand-in: to the Chinese camp's morgue and Yang's drawer (DLC04FF05MorgueDrawerYang, enabled by 50): it slides open, its message's second button takes the self-destruct codes (DLC04FF05DentalRecord; its OnAdd sets 60) [observed: DLC04FF05MorgueDrawerYangSCRIPT, DLC04FF05dentalCapsuleSCRIPT].

The button is picked at once: the drawer's GameMode block reads GetButtonPressed a second after the box shows and gives up on -1, and headless GameMode blocks go on running while the box is up (in play the box holds them) [observed].

Travel stand-in: out to the sunken Chinese submarine and in. Its operations terminal takes the codes (Initiate Self-Destruct: 65) and its self-destruct switch (DLC04FF05sunkenSatelliteSCRIPT, the message's second button) starts the countdown; once the player is out of the submarine the script waits 10 s, blows it up and sets 70 [observed: DLC04FF05script].
Travel stand-in: back out through the hatch and away from the submarine.

actions.label: milestone: DLC04FF05 70, back to the safehouse

actions.text: Down into the spy bunker: its protectron (DLC04FF05ProtectronREF) takes the passphrase (DLC04FF05protPassphrase: its Variable01 1, the escort package).

actions.label: protectron: this is a hazardous area

actions.text: Stand-in for the protectron's walk ahead (the AI's escort): it walks into the switch room's trigger (DLC04FF05protectronProdSCRIPT: 85, its 'Please step inside') [observed].

The debriefing is a double cross: the room fills with gas. The player gets out (the circuit box or the vent, DLC04FF05FuseBoxSCRIPT / the radiation vent) and through the way out, whose trigger (DLC04FF05escapeTrigSCRIPT) sets 100 [observed].
